text:
maria: Heads-up — partner asked if we can structure a smaller private-offer with a time-limited discount ladder to drive committed spend, but keep hardware credits separate. Thoughts?

devin: Have we done a staircase like that on marketplace before? small commits -> blended discount tiers. e.g., 3mo ramp 10% -> 15% -> 20% as a starter.

ajay: Sales concern — need a clear conversion trigger for marketplace billing vs the private offer. Customers previously got confused when appliance credits showed up as a separate line. :thinking_face:

maria: My thought: create a dedicated "commit-staircase" SKU that maps exclusively to the private-offer discount tiers. Hardware/appliance credits are a separate SKU/line item so they never automatically stack. Keeps billing and quotes clean.

sophia: Legal note: avoid language that implies the discounts are combinable rebates. We can do separate SKUs, but add explicit 'non-stackable' term and an appliance-credit redemption window (propose 90 days). I'll draft the clause.

devin: Example SKU mapping for ops/devs to review:
```
commit_staircase_v1:
  month1: 10%
  month2: 15%
  month3: 20%
hardware_credit:
  sku: HW-CREDIT-2026
  redemption_days: 90
```

ajay: Can we add an early-conversion bonus if they convert from trial/marketplace to private-offer within 45 days? That helps ARR and nudges customers to commit. :money_with_wings:

maria: Partner asked for verification — daily usage sync to validate commit attainment. Ops, can we publish a webhook/CSV feed to the partner so they can reconcile? pinging @partner-bot for a prototype.

partner-bot: Webhook created: https://hooks.redwood.ai/marketplace/partner/commit-sync — will post delta and cumulative commit attainment daily at 02:00 UTC. Delivery retries x3 on 5xx.

devin: Renewal signal idea: if customer hits >=90% of committed spend during term, auto-propose a 10% renewal uplift discount on the next term for a 7-day opt-in window. That becomes a conversion lever for renewals team.

sophia: Fine from legal in principle — I'll add the opt-in flow and one-time grace language. Need finance to confirm how uplift interacts with revenue recognition/tax.

maria: Action items: sophia to share clause draft by Friday; devin to finalize tier % and renewal window; ajay to prep a 1-pager sales play (customer-facing). We'll circle back once partner legal signs off and ops validates the webhook. :thumbsup:
